parameters.subject: Welcome to ISC — Let's unlock your supply chain potential
parameters.html:
Dear {{ $json.body.name }},

Thank you for your interest in I Supply Chain. We have reviewed your profile and believe we can help you achieve measurable improvements in your supply chain performance.

Over the next few days, we will share resources tailored to your industry. In the meantime, feel free to explore the platform.

Warm regards,
The ISC Team

Schedule a call →

Best,

parameters.name: message
parameters.value: =Lead {{ $('ISC Webhook — lead.captured').item.json.body.email }} has not replied after 48h — follow up manually.

setupSteps: 1. Import this JSON into n8n (Menu → Workflows → Import from file).
2. Connect your Gmail credential (Credentials → New → Gmail OAuth2).
3. Copy the Webhook URL shown at the top of the Webhook node.
4. In ISC → Admin → Integration Hub → Webhooks, create a new webhook with event 'lead.captured' and paste that URL.
5. Replace YOUR_ISC_DOMAIN with your platform URL and YOUR_CALENDAR_LINK with your booking URL.
6. Activate the workflow with the toggle at the top right.

nodeDetails.detail: Listens for the lead.captured event on path /isc-lead-captured
Sends subject: "Welcome to ISC — Let's unlock your supply chain potential" to the captured lead's email
Pauses the flow for 48 hours before checking for a reply
Checks whether body.replied === 'true' — true branch sends the discovery invite, false branch notifies admin
Sends subject: "Book a free discovery call — {name}" with a calendar booking link
POSTs to /api/admin/notify if the lead has not replied after 48 h
